# Lara's Pinnal - Comprehensive LLM Resource

> Lara's Pinnal is a handmade crochet gift studio located in Villupuram, Tamil Nadu, specializing in hand-knitted crochet flower bouquets, amigurumi plush toys, custom frames, keychains, and gift hampers. Every piece is crafted to order with premium milk cotton yarn and shipped safely across India.

## Core Products and Services

### Crochet Flower Bouquets
We hand-knit forever flowers that never wilt, including:
- **Rose Bouquets**: Classic single stems and full arrangements in custom colors — a keepsake alternative to fresh flowers.
- **Tulip & Lily Bouquets**: Elegant pastel arrangements popular for anniversaries, proposals, and birthdays.
- **Sunflower & Daisy Pieces**: Cheerful stems, coasters, keychains, and desk decor.
- **Custom Mixed Bouquets**: Fully personalized combinations — choose flowers, colors, wrapping, and add-on tags.

All flowers are crocheted from premium, hypoallergenic milk cotton yarn with meticulous attention to detail.

### Amigurumi Plushies & Gifts
We create handmade plush toys and small gifts cut out for every occasion.
- **Plushies Available**: Teddy bears, bunnies, and custom character amigurumi in made-to-order sizes.
- **Small Gifts**: Keychains, hair bands, bag charms, festive rakhis, and desk accessories.
- **Quality Assurance**: Baby-safe, hypoallergenic yarn and secure stitching make our plushies suitable for children and newborn gifting.

### Custom Frames & Gift Hampers
- **Crochet Portrait Frames**: Wooden embroidery-hoop frames with personalized crochet artwork, names, and dates.
- **Gift Hampers**: Curated hampers for baby showers, weddings, birthdays, and corporate gifting.

## Operational Philosophy

### Handmade, Made-to-Order Craft
Every product is crocheted by hand, to order — no mass production. Slight variations in yarn shade, shape, and sizing are signs of authentic handmade art. We customize colors, names, and patterns so each gift is uniquely yours.

### Quality Materials & Care
We work with premium milk cotton yarn chosen for softness, durability, and hypoallergenic properties. Finished pieces are inspected, carefully packaged, and shipped with care instructions so they stay beautiful for years.

### Committed to Community & Craft
We uphold the handicraft traditions of Tamil Nadu while bringing crochet art to modern gifting. Lara's Pinnal is an independent local studio — every order directly supports a local artisan.
